t: 3 g of activated charcoal was added to 50 mL of acetic acid solution (0.06N) in a flask. After an hour it was filtered and the strength of the filtrate was found to be 0.042 N. The amount of acetic acid adsorbed (per gram of charcoal) is:
s:
Let the weight of acetic acid initially be w₁ in 50 mL of 0.060 N solution. N=(w₁×1000)/M.wt.×50( Normality =0.06N)
0.06=(w₁×1000)/(60×50)
⇒w₁=(0.06×60×50)/1000=0.18g=180mg
After an hour, the strength of acetic acid =0.042N
so, let the weight of acetic acid be w₂
N=w₂/60×1000
0.042=(w₂×1000)/3000
⇒w₂=0.126g=126mg
So amount of acetic acid adsorbed per 3 g =180−126mg=54mg
∴ amount of acetic acid absorbed per g=54/3=18mg
